hypothesis: A bounded result audit can accept or reject the M2505 public benchmark pack without turning source-only diagnostics into performance, validation, ranking, or paper claims.
success_criteria: audit verifies all required pack files exist
audit verifies artifact_manifest.csv references existing source artifacts
audit verifies actor_contract.md states P0 observation shape 72 and action shape 3
audit verifies claim boundaries reject performance ranking success-rate validation paper finite-window-vs-GRU and self-ID claims
audit verifies summary flags mark policy action training ranking winner success-rate performance validation and paper claim flags false
no external high-fidelity simulation install import execution policy action training ranking winner success-rate or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2506 installs imports or runs Chrono or another external simulator
M2506 changes actor input or action contract
M2506 injects hidden or oracle actor features
M2506 executes policy actions or rollout
M2506 treats benchmark pack materialization as driver performance
M2506 ranks controller families or selects a winner
M2506 claims high-fidelity validation paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID result
decision_rule: M2506 passes if it audits the M2505 public diagnostic pack and confirms required files, source references, actor contract, claim boundaries, and false claim flags without external simulation, policy action, training, ranking, winner selection, success-rate, or verdict claims.
